svg.text: 1 Academic classes added: Program, ProgramSubject, Subject {abstract}, QCAASubject, VETUnit,
Term, Enrolment, Result, Qualification; placement classes added: HostEmployer,
2 Composition corrected: the filled diamond sits at the Invoice (whole) end.
3 Billing-account category modelled through «interface» AccountHolder (exactly one holder).
4 phoneNumber is [0..*] (20 of the 42 people have no phone); staffedBy removed – not in the
schema: a trainer's campuses follow from the offerings they lead. Shared aggregation
is now Program ◇ Subject: a subject exists independently and is shared by programs.
Associations without an arrowhead are bidirectional; ▶ gives the reading direction of a name.
